item.title: Show HN: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
item.description:
📝 To build from source: make setup && make build → bin/mindwalk. With no arguments, mindwalk scans ~/. Keep Go code gofmt-ed; never hand-edit internal/server/static — regenerate it with make build.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/cosmtrek/mindwalk
